# Welcome to Lovable

Copy pageCopy page

Lovable is a full-stack AI development platform for building, iterating on, and deploying web applications using natural language, with real code, security, and enterprise governance.

Copy pageCopy page

![Welcome Lovable Dashboard](https://mintcdn.com/lovable-f9060f1e/ybHXd0Cn2UWhku0A/images/welcome-lovable-dashboard.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=ybHXd0Cn2UWhku0A&q=85&s=7063addda22ec0066d45e5ece92559c4)

Lovable lets individuals and teams build production-grade web applications using natural language. You describe what you want to build, and Lovable generates a working application that includes frontend, backend, database, authentication, and integrations, all backed by editable code. Lovable supports the full lifecycle of modern product development, from early exploration and prototyping to deployment and ongoing operation. Applications are built inside shared [workspaces](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/workspace), where a group of people builds from one plan and a shared pool of credits, each working on one or more of their own projects. Each project represents a single application and produces a codebase that can be synced to GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket with [Git sync](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/git-sync-overview) and integrated into existing engineering workflows. The platform is built to help people move faster while maintaining ownership, security, and operational control. You can start for free, and plans are priced by [credits](https://docs.lovable.dev/introduction/credits-and-usage), not by projects or seats. See [Subscription plans](https://docs.lovable.dev/introduction/subscription-plans).

## Start building for free

Create a free account with email, Google, GitHub, or Apple, and start building immediately.

## Quick start

Build and publish your first app in about ten minutes.

## Browse Lovable templates

Start from a ready-made app you can remix on any plan.

## Learn in the Lovable Academy

Free video walkthroughs and a guided learning path from the Lovable team.

## 

[​

](https://docs.lovable.dev/introduction/welcome#core-concepts)

Core concepts

Four terms come up everywhere in Lovable:

*   **Account**: Your personal identity on Lovable. You [log in with one account](https://docs.lovable.dev/introduction/create-an-account) and use it across every workspace you belong to.
*   **Workspace**: Where you and your team work. A [workspace](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/workspace) holds projects, members, billing, and a shared pool of credits.
*   **Project**: One app. Each [project](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/projects/overview) holds its project chat, preview, code, and version history, and lives in exactly one workspace.
*   **Chats**: Conversations with Lovable outside your projects, for thinking through ideas, asking about your apps, and working with connected tools. When something needs building, a [chat](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/chats) sends the work to a project.

## 

[​

](https://docs.lovable.dev/introduction/welcome#why-use-lovable)

Why use Lovable

Lovable makes it easier to go from an idea to working software. **Faster iteration**  
Move from idea to working software by building through natural language instead of starting from a blank codebase. **Collaboration when you need it**  
Work solo or with a team. Lovable supports shared workspaces so people across roles can contribute in one place when collaboration matters. **Code ownership and flexibility**  
Keep full ownership of your code and integrate Lovable into existing workflows. **Built with enterprise needs in mind**  
[Security, privacy, and governance capabilities](https://docs.lovable.dev/introduction/lovable-for-enterprise) are built into the platform from the start.

## 

[​

](https://docs.lovable.dev/introduction/welcome#who-lovable-is-for)

Who Lovable is for

Lovable is used by teams inside companies, by technical teams and agencies, across enterprises, and by people building on their own. **Teams in companies**

*   Product managers and designers turning prototypes into internal tools the business runs on
*   Operations, sales, marketing, finance, and HR teams replacing spreadsheets and per-seat software with their own apps
*   Marketers building landing pages, campaign sites, and dashboards

**Technical teams and agencies**

*   Developers using Lovable to quickly set up projects, internal tools, and early prototypes
*   Engineering teams reviewing, extending, and maintaining generated code through GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket
*   Agencies and consultancies delivering client projects where code ownership and portability matter

**Enterprises**

*   Teams building internal tools or business-critical applications used across the organization
*   Organizations building and operating applications with [security, compliance, and governance](https://docs.lovable.dev/introduction/lovable-for-enterprise) requirements
*   Companies integrating AI-assisted development into established engineering workflows

**Individual builders**

*   Founders and entrepreneurs launching products and reaching their first customers
*   Independent makers building side projects, prototypes, or small products on their own
*   Students and educators working on coursework, learning projects, or experiments

## 

[​

](https://docs.lovable.dev/introduction/welcome#what-you-can-build-with-lovable)

What you can build with Lovable

Lovable supports a broad range of web applications, from early exploration to production systems, and also creates the presentations, documents, and visual assets around them. **Prototypes and proofs of concept**  
Working prototypes with real data and logic, so product, design, and sales teams can validate an idea before engineering builds it **SaaS and business applications**

# Build Documentations in Minutes with AI

Build Documentation Pages in minutes. Let Lovable help you create structured, user-friendly pages for guides, APIs, and manuals.

### A superhuman full stack product engineer.

#### Instant & intuitive

Live rendering, handles image input, has instant undo and lets you collaborate with branching. The AI fixes your bugs. One-click deploy when ready.

#### Beautiful design

We believe your product should look good. Lovable follows best practice UI & UX principles to make sure every idea you bring to life is beautifully designed.

#### Support any backend

Lovable has support for databases, API integrations and back-end functionality. Connect your own or use our Supabase connector.

#### Select & edit

The accuracy you need to make fine grained changes. With Select & Edit you click an element and describe what you want updated.

#### GitHub integration

Connect Lovable to your GitHub account to automatically sync the code to your repository. Perfect for project hand offs and more advanced workflows.

### Frequently asked questions

### How much does it cost to build Documentation Pages with Lovable?

Free users can start public projects, and have a limited number of AI credits. Paid users can create private projects and have more AI credits.

### How can I get started to build documentation page, documentation tool, documentation platform ?

Simply sign up and start chatting with Lovable about what you want to build.

### How much time does it take to build a Documentation Pages with Lovable?

Most projects can be built in minutes to hours, depending on complexity.

### What is Lovable and how does it work?

Lovable is an AI software engineer, which enables anyone to build for the web. Simply chat to instantly build websites and web apps, with no technical knowledge needed.

### What is a credit?

Credits are units Lovable uses to measure and pay for usage across your workspace. Credits let you build apps, run deployed apps, and power AI features from one balance. The value of a credit and the rate at which they are consumed for a given action depend on your subscription plan and the feature used, and credits are not necessarily equal in value across different plans.

### How do I use credits in Lovable?

Paid plans have access to a credit balance. Credits from your balance can be used in Lovable for building by sending messages to Lovable, hosting with Cloud, and offering AI features to users as part of your app.

In addition to your credit balance, Pro and Business subscriptions include grants for building and hosting with Cloud.

For building, pricing varies by mode:

**Default Mode:** credits vary based on task complexity

**Plan Mode:** 1 credit per message

Here are some example prompts and their cost:

|     |     |     |
| --- | --- | --- |Here are some example prompts and their cost:
| User Prompt | Work Done | Credits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| “Make the button gray” | Updates the button styles | 0.50 |
| “Remove the footer” | Removes the footer component | 0.90 |
| “Add authentication with sign up and login” | Adds authentication pages and logic, updates routes | 1.20 |
| “Build me a landing page, use images” | Creates a landing page with 3 generated images, theme, and 5 sections | 1.70 |

You can see the cost of each message in the message history by hovering over the three dots of an message.

![View credits cost on each message](https://lovable.dev/cdn-cgi/image/width=1000,f=auto,fit=scale-down/https://assets.lovable.dev/img/marketing-content/_shared/faq/view-credits-on-message.png)

# Insights

Copy pageCopy page

See how your workspace adopts Lovable, with visits, active apps, active builders, connections added, top apps ranked by visits, and builders ranked by edits.

Copy pageCopy page

Insights shows workspace admins and owners how their workspace adopts Lovable: which apps people build, which apps people use, and who builds them. Use Insights to understand adoption across your workspace, find the apps that people use most, and see how building activity changes over time. It answers questions such as which apps your teams rely on, how many people build in Lovable each month, and whether that number is growing.

This page is about **Insights**, the adoption dashboard for your workspace. Looking for which projects need security or ownership attention? See [Security insights](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/security-insights). Looking for one app’s traffic in detail? See [Project analytics](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/analytics). All three are different features.

*   **Available on:** Business and Enterprise plans
*   **Access:** Workspace admins and owners
*   **Location:** [**Workspace settings → Workspace → Insights**](https://lovable.dev/settings/workspace-insights)

Insights does not consume credits, whether you view it or export its data.

## 

[​

](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/insights#what-you-can-do)

What you can do

*   See how many visits, active apps, and active builders your workspace had over the last 30 days, and how many connections your teams added to apps through connectors.
*   Compare each of those numbers with the 30 days before to see whether adoption grows or slows.
*   Chart active apps and visits by day, week, or month.
*   Review your top apps by visits, including what each app does, who it is for, and who contributed to it. Open any app’s own analytics for more detail.
*   Open the full app list to search, filter by category, and sort every app in the workspace by name, category, owner, visits, or edits.
*   See every workspace member ranked by edits, with their role, apps owned, visits to their apps, credit use, and a week-by-week view of their building activity.
*   For workspaces that get member departments from [SCIM](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/business/scim) or from [SSO](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/business/sso), see how many members of each department build on Lovable.
*   Export the full app list or the full builder list to a CSV file for reporting and leadership reviews.

## 

[​

](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/insights#how-insights-differs-from-security-insights-and-project-analytics)

How Insights differs from Security insights and Project analytics

Lovable has three features with similar names. They answer different questions.

| Feature | Question it answers | Scope |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Insights** (this page) | How much does my workspace build, and who uses what it builds? | Every app in the workspace |
| [**Security insights**](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/security-insights) | Which projects need security or ownership attention? | Every app in the workspace |
| [**Project analytics**](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/analytics) | Where do one app’s visitors come from, and what do they do? | A single app |

Insights and [Project analytics](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/analytics) count visits from the same source. Insights covers the last 30 days for every app at once. Project analytics covers one app, lets you choose the period, and breaks traffic down by source, page, device, and country.

## 

[​

](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/insights#terms-used-on-this-page)

Terms used on this page

*   An **app** is any project in your workspace, published or not. Every count of apps on this page includes unpublished apps unless it says otherwise.
*   A **builder** is any member of the workspace, whatever their role, including external collaborators. The builders list shows every member, whether or not they have edited anything. **Active builders** counts only the members who built something in the last 30 days.
*   A **visit** is one person opening a published app. The same person returning later counts as another visit, and so does a reload or a new tab, so visits do not count unique people. Only published apps can have visits.
*   A **connection** is one account you have linked to an external service, for example one Stripe account. A **connector** is the type of service, such as Stripe. One connection can be used by several apps. Insights counts [app + chat connections](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/app-connectors), including connections to [custom connectors](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/create-connector) your workspace created. It does not count [chat connectors](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/custom-mcp) (MCP servers) or [app user connections](https://docs.lovable.dev/integrations/app-user-connectors).

## 

[​

](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/insights#overview)

Overview

The overview shows four metric cards, two charts, and the date the numbers are current through. Workspaces whose members have a department also see an [**Adoption by department**](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/insights#adoption-by-department) card.

### 

[​

](https://docs.lovable.dev/features/insights#metrics)

Metrics

The cards are, in order, **App visits**, **Active apps**, **Active builders**, and **Connections added**. Each number covers the last 30 days. Next to it, Lovable shows the percentage change from the 30 days before, so you can see whether the number is rising or falling. Hover over the percentage to see the two numbers it compares, shown as **Previous 30d** and **Current 30d**.

| --- | --- |
| **App visits (30d)** | Visits to published apps in the last 30 days. One person visiting on two days counts as two visits. This is not a count of unique people. |
